End to end security for privileged access

Protect your privileged accounts (Active Directory, Linux or Windows) easily with AuthNull's automated privileged access platform

Discover your blindspots in minutes

AuthNull can scan tens of thousands of endpoints to identify potential footholds for attackers and continuous scanning means no more account sprawl.

Features

AuthNull's provides comprehensive privileged access managemnt platform including

Active Directory Protection

Protect your active directory - discover and manage privileged accounts including service accounts. Discover authentication policies and issue just in time privileges.

Database Protection

Out of the box support for MSSQL, Oracle and Postgres and MySQL. Discover and protect privileged accounts in your databases.

Learn more

Auto discover authentication policies

AuthNull can automatically discover authentication policies for you to make it easy to setup authentication.

Learn more

Session auditing / recording

AuthNull can automatically record all sessions for compliance reasons, for those servers which connect through a jump server.

Remove local admin rights

Endpoint privilege manager enables you to remove local admin rights with policies that enable JIT access.

Enable Policy Based Access Control

AuthNull enables you to rollout zero trust with granular policy based access control

Learn more

Enforce Biometric MFA

AuthNull can enable biometric MFA across Active Directory infrastructure, Linux and Windows local users

Learn more

Privileged Account and Session Management Features

01

Discover / Synchronize Active directory and local root / other users and groups

Discover and synchronize users and groups two way, ensuring that all privileged accounts are identified and managed.

02

Identify and Isolate Service Accounts

AuthNull enables you to identify and isolate service accounts so that they are not a part of the standard PAM feature functions.

03

Enable MFA with Biometrics at Scale

Enable MFA with biometrics at scale instantly for thousands of endpoints.

04

Enable local admin management. Enable Root bypass

Enable shared access to local admin accounts by checking out users on demand. Enable password rotation. If necessary configure local root bypass.

05

Centralized policy management

Manage central policies for endpoints in a single location.

06

Centralized rotation of credentials

Rotate credentials in a centralized manner with AuthNull to stay in compliance.

07

Centralized Endpoint Service Management

Manage installation and configuration of SSH, RDP and other services on the endpoints.
